verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तमुद्यतं महाबाहुं दुःशासनरथं प्रति। त्वरितं त्वरणीयेषु धनञ्जयजयैषिणम्॥१॥
त्रिगर्तानां महेष्वासाः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। सेनासमुद्रमाविष्टमनन्तं पर्यवारयन् ॥२॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then the mighty archers of the Trigartta clan, all owning gold-decked standards, surrounded on all sides the mighty-armed Satyaki-that hero who performed with activity everything that demanded promptness and who having penetrated into that host fathomless as the ocean, was advancing against Dushasana's chariot, for giving victory of Dhananjaya.

verses.sanskrit: अथैनं रथवंशेन सर्वतः सन्निवार्य ते। अवाकिरञ्छरव्रातैः क्रुद्धाः परमधन्विनः॥३॥
अजयद्राजपुत्रांस्तान् भ्राजमानान्महारणे। एकः पञ्चाशतं शत्रून्सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥४॥
verses.english: But the unsupported Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, conquered his fifth antagonists, all princes of the Trigartta race looking very beautiful in battle.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य भारतीमध्यं तलघोषसमाकुलम्। असि-शक्ति-गदापूर्णमप्लवं सलिलं यथा ॥५॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शैनेयचरितं रणे। प्रतीच्यां दिशि तं दृष्ट्वा प्राच्यां पश्यामि लाघवात्॥६॥
verses.english: We then behold the wonderful conduct of Sini's grandson, for beholding him now in the Western direction, we immediately after beheld him in the Eastern direction, so great indeed was his lightness of movements.

verses.sanskrit: उदीचीं दक्षिणां प्राचीं प्रतीचीं विदिशस्तथा। नृत्यन्निवाचरच्छूरो यथा रथशतं तथा॥७॥
तद्दृष्ट्वा चरितं तस्य सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनः। त्रिगर्ताः संन्यवर्तन्त सन्तप्ताः स्वजनं प्रति॥८॥
तमन्ये शूरसेनानां शूराः संख्ये न्यवारयन्। नियच्छन्तः शरव्रातैर्मत्तं द्विपमिवाङ्कुशैः॥९॥
तैर्व्यवाहरदार्यात्मा मुहूर्तादेव सात्यकिः। ततः कलिङ्गैर्युयुधे सोऽचिन्त्यबलविक्रमः॥१०॥
verses.english: The illustrious Satyaki fought with them only for a while and then that hero of inconceivable prowess commenced his fight with the Kalingas.

verses.sanskrit: तां च सेनामतिक्रम्य कलिङ्गानां दुरत्ययाम्। अथ पार्थं महाबाहुर्धनञ्जयमुपासदत्॥११॥
तरन्निव जले श्रान्तो यथा स्थलमुपेयिवान्। तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रं युयुधानः समाश्वसत्॥१२॥
verses.english: Then like an exhausted swimmer reaching land, the heroic Yuyudhana became comforted on obtaining sight of Dhananjaya that foremost of men.

verses.sanskrit: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य केशवः पार्थमब्रवीत्। असावायाति शैनेयस्तव पार्थ पदानुगः॥१३॥
एष शिष्यः सखा चैव तव सत्यपराक्रमः। सर्वान् योधांस्तृणीकृत्य विजिग्ये पुरुषर्षभः॥१४॥
verses.english: O your of true prowess, Satyaki is your friend and pupil. That foremost of men, holding all the warriors of the hostile host a pins fee, has vanquished them all. near

verses.sanskrit: एष कौरवयोधानां कृत्वा घोरमुपद्रवम्। तव प्राणैः प्रियतमः किरीटिन्नेति सात्यकिः॥१५॥
verses.english: Inflicting dreadful loss upon the Kauravas, Satyaki dear unto you like your own life, is coming towards you, O diadem-decked one!

verses.sanskrit: एष द्रोणं तथा भोजं कृतवर्माणमेव च। कदर्थीकृत्य विशिखैः फाल्गुनाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥१६॥
verses.english: Having worsted with his arrows, Drona and Kritavarman of the Bhoja race, this Satyaki is approaching you, O Phalguna.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराजप्रियान्वेषी हत्वा योधान् वरान् वरान्। शूरश्चैव कृतास्त्रश्च फाल्गुनाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥१७॥
verses.english: Having slain numerous warriors all best of their class, the valorous Satyaki ever solicitous of the welfare of Yudhishthira and accomplished in the use of weapons, is approaching you, O Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा सुदुष्करं कर्म सैन्यमध्ये महाबलः। तव दर्शनमन्विच्छन् पाण्डवाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥१८॥
verses.english: O son of Pandu, the puissant Satya is coming to you have achieved numerous difficult feats in the midst of the Kaurava host.

verses.sanskrit: बहूनेकरथेनाजौ योधयित्वा महारथान्। आचार्यप्रमुखान् पार्थ प्रयात्येष स सात्यकिः॥१९॥
verses.english: Having encountered on a single car many mighty car-warriors having Drona at their head, the heroic Satyaki is approaching you, O Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य विदार्य च वरूथिनीम्। प्रेषितो धर्मराजेन पार्थैषोऽभ्येति सात्यकिः ॥२०॥
यस्य नास्ति समो योधः कौरवेषु कथञ्चन। सोऽयमायाति कौन्तेय सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः॥२१॥
कुरुसैन्याद्विमुक्तो वै सिंहो मध्याद्गवामिव। निहत्य बहुलाःसेनाः पार्थैषोभ्येति सात्यकिः॥२२॥
एष राजसहस्राणां वक्त्रैः पङ्कजसन्निभैः। आस्तीर्य वसुधां पार्थ क्षिप्रमायाति सात्यकिः॥२३॥
एष दुर्योधनं जित्वा भ्रातृभिः सहितं रणे। निहत्य जलसन्धं च क्षिप्रमायाति सात्यकिः॥२४॥
रुधिरौघवतीं कृत्वा नदीं शोणितकर्दमाम्। तृणवद्व्यस्य कौरव्यानेष ह्यायाति सात्यकिः॥२५॥
verses.english: Yonder comes Satyaki, having created a river of blood with clots of blood for its mire and having disregarded the Kauravas like some any straws."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टः कौन्तेयः केशवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। न मे प्रियं महाबाहो यन्मामभ्येति सात्यकिः॥२६॥
verses.english: Hearing these words of Keshava Kunti's son although filled with delight replied to the former saying-"O mighty-armed one, I am not pleased to find that Satyaki is coming to me.

verses.sanskrit: न हि जानामि वृत्तान्तं धर्मराजस्य केशव। सात्वतेन विहीनः स यदि जीवति वा न वा॥२७॥
verses.english: O Keshava, I do not know the where abouts of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. I am doubtful whether he lives or not, being deprived of the help of this Satvata hero.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन हि महाबाहो रक्षितव्यः स पार्थिवः। तमेष कथमुत्सृज्य मम कृष्ण पदानुगः॥२८॥
verses.english: O mighty-armed one, it should have been this one's first duty to protect the king in battle. O Krishna, wherefore has then this one : abandoning him has followed in my wake?

verses.sanskrit: राजा द्रोणाय चोत्सृष्टः सैन्धवश्चानिपातितः। प्रत्युद्याति च शैनेयमेष भूरिश्रवा रणे ॥२९॥
verses.english: The king has been left to the mercy of Drona; the ruler of the Sindhus is still unslain and yonder does Bhurisravas rush against Satyaki in battle.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽयं गुरुतरो भारः सैन्धवार्थे समाहितः। ज्ञातव्यश्च हि मे राजा रक्षितव्यश्च सात्यकिः॥३०॥
जयद्रथश्च हन्तव्यो लम्बते च दिवाकरः। श्रान्तश्चैष महाबाहुरल्पप्राणश्च सांप्रतम्॥३१॥
परिश्रान्ता हयाश्चास्य हययन्ता च माधव। न च भूरिश्रवा श्रान्तः ससहायश्च केशव॥३२॥
verses.english: His horses are tired and O Madhava his driver is worn out with fatigue. On the other hand, O Keshava, Bhurisrava is not at all fatigued and moreover he is well supported.

verses.sanskrit: अपीदानीं भवेदस्य क्षेममस्मिन् समागमे। कश्चिन्न सागरं तीर्त्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥३३॥
verses.english: Will Satyaki reap victory in this encounter? Having crossed the ocean itself will Satyaki of prowess incapable of being vanquished.

verses.sanskrit: गोष्पदं प्राप्य सीदेत महौजाः शिनिपुङ्गवः। अपि कौरवमुख्येन कृतास्त्रेण महात्मना॥३४॥
verses.english: Will that foremost of scion of the Sini race, will that highly energetic one, succumb in crossing the little water contained in the vestige of a cow's hoof? Will Satyaki obtain good fortune having encountered Bhurisravas that foremost of the Kurus, who is high-souled and accomplished in the use of weapons? That he should dispatch Satyaki after me, dismissing all his fears from Drona, O Keshava, I think this to be a mistake committed by the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. Like a hawk when ranging through the skies, ever trying to pounce upon a piece of meat, Drona is ever endeavouring to effect the capture of the very virtuous king. Will the king fare well?" foremost of the Kurus, who is high-souled and accomplished in the use of weapons? That he should dispatch Satyaki after me, dismissing all his fears from Drona, O Keshava, I think this to be a mistake committed by the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. Like a hawk when ranging through the skies, ever trying to pounce upon a piece of meat, Drona is ever endeavouring to effect the capture of the very virtuous king. Will the king fare well?"

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य भूरिश्रवसा स्वस्तिमान्सात्यकिर्भवेत्। व्यतिक्रममिमं मन्ये धर्मराजस्य केशव॥३५॥
आचार्याद्भयमुत्सृज्य यः प्रैषयत सात्यकिम्। ग्रहणं धर्मराजस्य खगः श्येन इवामिषम्॥३६॥
नित्यमाशंसते द्रोणः कच्चित् स्यात्कुशली नृपः॥३७॥
